bugs.what: A mint lookup returns pairs that only quote that mint. Searching USDC returns unrelated base tokens (BIRB, CARDS, PUMP) whose only USDC field is quoteToken.address.
bugs.evidence: Both q= and address= returned 200, lookedUp true, total 4, in 0.61s and 1.29s. Hits: USDC/SOL pancakeswap (base is USDC, correct); BIRB G7vQWurMkMMm2dU3iZpXYFTHT9Biio4F4gZCrwFpKNwG pair GUWFT7bb… quote USDC; CARDS CARDSccUMFKoPRZxt5vt3ksUbxEFEcnZ3H2pd3dKxYjp quote USDC; PUMP pumpCmXqMfrsAkQ5r49WcJnRayYRqmXz6ae8H7H9Dfn dex pumpswap quote USDC. Walking every string on BIRB/CARDS/PUMP, the USDC mint appears only at quoteToken.address.

bugs.what: totalSupplyFormatted is the raw integer, not the decimal-adjusted supply. The holder panel prints it as Total Supply, so this Pump mint shows 1e15 instead of 1e9.
bugs.evidence: 200 in 0.16s, source onchain-solana-rugcheck. Body: totalSupply 1000000000000000, totalSupplyFormatted "1,000,000,000,000,000", decimals 6, totalHolders 3, top10SupplyPercentage 100. Top holder balance 1000000000 (ui amount) at 100%, which only matches a 1,000,000,000 token supply. UI renders totalSupplyFormatted next to the symbol.

bugs.what: Ticker search uses endsWith, so a short word matches a longer ticker that merely ends with those letters. q=GRAM returns PROGRAM and ARGRAM even though the name/ticker is not the word GRAM. No mint-only hit was returned (symbol or name always contained the letters).
bugs.evidence: 200, totals fluctuated 31–38 as the live index changed (0.75s–3.7s). Stable false positives: PROGRAM / program, mint xQgNwXsp6wwGs76JLiqsPDVyuH7B9Q92EJ8PAc7bonk; ARGRAM / Argus Social, 0x75d7c00dc786e30eF2f8678981A062ceAc21C8CB. An earlier pull in the same run also returned INSTAGRAM, IMAGEGRAM, inustagram, and $Monogram (name "Felix Koutchinski"). q=gram and q=GRAM are the same matcher; the one-token case gap was a live insert, not case sensitivity. q=telegram&shape=browse returned 40/40 name-or-ticker word matches (including names like "THE FOMOAPP TELEGRAM BOT") and zero mint-only rows; results are capped at 40.

A later 9-token trending page still had robinhood GIWAS "6ZQXsy6sVtnHGGYi" and KURO "icpu326GTEvetoHN". Latest pump rows use https://images.pump.fun/... and were fine (0/80 bad).

bugs.what: Graduated Pons tokens on Robinhood are labeled dexId pumpswap and primaryDex PumpSwap. Chain, launch platform, logo, and sources say Pons. The PumpSwap dex filter does not return them.
bugs.evidence: ORBIX 0x60633794dF09856B339eEA8bd741D749596b5230, GIWAS, KURO, PROV: chainId robinhood, dexId pumpswap, primaryDex PumpSwap, primaryDexLogo /pons.png, launchPlatform Pons V2, isPonsLaunch true, marketStage graduated, sources [Pons V2, Uniswap], primaryDexTradingUrl null, url https://ponsfamily.com/launchpad/<address>. ORBIX volume.h24 252824.47 vs liquidity.usd 23624.2, priceChange.h24 37.84. GET /api/discovery?dex=PumpSwap&chain=robinhood&mode=latest&limit=15&age=all → 200, total 0. Fresh robinhood latest rows are dexId pons / primaryDex Pons V2.

bugs.what: Unknown or wrong-case mode is silently coerced to trending. The body says mode trending, so the client is not told the mode was rejected.
bugs.evidence: mode=nope → 200 in 2.52s, mode "trending", total 10, limit 5000 (default). mode=LATEST → 200 in 1.76s, total 10 trending, not the ~8000-row latest feed.

bugs.what: Empty or whitespace q is ignored and the default trending browse page is returned, not an empty search.
bugs.evidence: 200 in ~2.2–2.5s. Body is a trending page: success true, mode trending, age 1w, limit 5000, total 21, ~35KB. A 500-char q returned 200 {"success":true,"total":0,"tokens":[]} in 0.09s.

bugs.what: Missing and garbage addresses return HTTP 200 with totalHolders 0, so callers that only check status treat the failure as an empty holder set.
bugs.evidence: No params: 200 in 0.002s, error "Missing token address parameter", totalHolders 0. not-an-address: 200 in 0.56s, message "No holder data available for this SOLANA token address", holders []. Valid JSON, not a 500.

bugs.what: Invalid limit, age, and cursor still wait on the live-snapshot race before the 400 is returned. Not a hang (>20s), but error paths cost ~2.5s.
bugs.evidence: limit=0 → 400 in 2.52s {"success":false,"error":"limit must be a finite integer from 1 to 5000"}. age=banana → 400 in 2.53s. cursor=%%% (raw and %25%25%25) → 400 in 2.51s {"error":"cursor is not valid"}. Healthy list calls were 1.2–2.7s; health itself is 5ms.
